summary: Learn Scope 3 boundaries, calculations, supplier data and reduction planning. Build practical inventory outputs. Explore the course.
lede: Scope 3 GHG accounting helps sustainability, procurement, supply-chain, finance and reporting professionals trace value-chain emissions. This training supports the practical work of building an inventory and turning findings into supplier and reduction actions, including setting boundaries, screening categories, and calculating spend- and activity-based estimates. Participants also practise assessing data quality, prioritising categories, documenting assumptions, and planning supplier engagement.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare or use organisational greenhouse-gas inventories, manage value-chain data, or translate emissions estimates into procurement and reporting decisions.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with organisational greenhouse-gas reporting or sustainability data is recommended. No coding is required; spreadsheet use is expected for calculation exercises.
